paragraphs.text: 1. FROM both thy nostrils, from thine eyes, from both thine ears and from thy chin,
Forth from thy head and brain and tongue I drive thy malady away.
paragraphs.original: यक्ष्मं शीर्षण्यं मस्तिष्काज्जिह्वाया वि वृहामि ते
paragraphs.translit: yakṣmaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ mastiṣkājjihvāyā vi vṛhāmi te

paragraphs.text: 2. From the neck-tendons and the neck, from the breast-bones and from the spine,
From shoulders, upper, lower arms, I drive thy malady away.
paragraphs.original: यक्ष्मं दोषण्यमंसाभ्यां बाहुभ्यां वि वृहामि ते
paragraphs.translit: yakṣmaṃ doṣaṇyamaṃsābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ vi vṛhāmi te

paragraphs.text: 3. From viscera and all within, forth from the rectum, from the heart,
From kidneys, liver, and from spleen, I drive thy malady away.
paragraphs.original: यक्ष्मं मतस्नाभ्यां यक्नः प्लाशिभ्यो वि वृहामि ते
paragraphs.translit: yakṣmaṃ matasnābhyāṃ yaknaḥ plāśibhyo vi vṛhāmi te

paragraphs.text: 4. From thighs, from knee-caps, and from heels, and from the forepart of the feet,
From hips from stomach, and from groin I drive thy malady away.
paragraphs.original: यक्ष्मं श्रोणिभ्यां भासदाद्भंससो वि वृहामि ते
paragraphs.translit: yakṣmaṃ śroṇibhyāṃ bhāsadādbhaṃsaso vi vṛhāmi te

paragraphs.text: 5. From what is voided from within, and from thy hair, and from they nails,
From all thyself from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.
6. From every member, every hair, disease that comes in every joint,
From all thyself, from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.
